method: Ordinary portal flow (guest entry, cabinet, Free mode, active hero, Begin Level) on a local static build of apps/portal; the child loading panel copy was read back from the DOM for each session seed until every insertion point had been observed. No copy was injected. Screenshots are retained outside the repository; their sha256 values are recorded here.

slots.objective: Work east through the camp toward the Liquidation Yard.
slots.watch: The mining yard south-east is an arena, and its relief valve vents a steam hazard when run.
slots.supply: The Machine Gun is in the control room to the north-east.
slots.tip: Your weapon fires on its own. Spend your attention on footwork and on where the crowd is thickest.

readyState.status: Ready when you are. Take a moment to plan your run.

slots.objective: Follow the road east through the relay gate into Rugpull Ravine.

slots.supply: A medkit cache sits south-east. The farmstead power station to the south opens a supply gate while you stand near it.

slots.objective: Salvage the ravine, then follow it east to the Proof-of-Work bridge.
slots.watch: The ambush bowl south-east funnels the horde. The quarry winch beyond it opens the salvage gate when held.
slots.supply: The Shotgun waits to the south, below the road.
slots.tip: Throw grenades into the thickest pack, not at the nearest enemy.

slots.objective: Cross the beacon clearing and head east into the Mining Camp.
slots.watch: You start inside the clearing arena; enemies close from the tree line on every side.
slots.supply: The Berserk candle rests at the shrine to the south. The woodland sanctuary, also south, heals you while you hold it.
slots.tip: Dodges and close combat trigger on their own. Keep moving so they have room to work.
